hero.subtitle: Plug Amazon login into your app with one shared Code Exchange flow for web and mobile.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Login with Amazon uses the standard OAuth2 Authorization Code flow. After consent, the API creates a short-lived single-use exchange code in Redis and then your client exchanges it for the same JWTs you get from password login.

console.title: Amazon Developer Console
console.description: Create a Security Profile in the Login with Amazon console, open Web Settings, and set Allowed Return URLs to match AMAZON_CALLBACK_URL. Scope: profile (user_id, email, name).

api.title: API contract
api.description: The API exposes a start URL and a callback that issues the exchange code.

codeHeader.label: Start
codeHeader.context: Redirect the user to Amazon consent

codeHeader.label: Callback
codeHeader.context: Amazon redirects back to the API

userModel.title: User model
userModel.description: Amazon's unique user identifier is stored as `amazonId` on the user record (profile `user_id`). Email comes from the profile scope.
